root.label: Scott Bessent Treasury management and results as of October 2026

events.label: Scott Bessent Treasury management and results as of October 2026

slots.name: appointment date
slots.sentence: Since he became Treasury secretary in early 2025, Bessent has dressed down senior advisers and junior staffers alike over issues large and small, according to more than a dozen current and former Treasury officials.

slots.name: GDP growth rate
slots.sentence: But growth has been around 2%, and oil production has increased less than a million barrels a day since Trump took office.

slots.name: budget deficit GDP percentage
slots.sentence: The budget deficit is now over 6% of GDP, according to the Committee for a Responsible Federal Budget.

slots.name: national debt amount
slots.sentence: U.S. debt overall recently topped $40 trillion.

slots.name: 10-year Treasury yield
slots.sentence: A deepening selloff in U.S. government bonds has driven the yield on the 10-year U.S. Treasury note to highs last seen more than two decades ago, despite a stepped-up buyback program Bessent set into motion to contain the increase.

slots.name: 3-3-3 policy goals
slots.sentence: Bessent advised Trump to pursue a “3-3-3” policy: cutting the budget deficit to 3% of gross domestic product by 2028, spurring GDP growth of 3% and producing an additional three million barrels of oil a day.

slots.name: senior adviser appointment
slots.sentence: Last week, Treasury announced David Zervos, a longtime Wall Street market strategist and a top executive at Jefferies, would become a senior adviser to Bessent.

slots.name: blocked reporters count
slots.sentence: After the Journal wrote a story about Bessent’s purchase of government bonds that Bessent objected to, the Treasury Department blocked a Journal reporter from attending a press conference where the secretary announced his plan to isolate Iran through stepped-up economic sanctions.

slots.name: revoked credentials count
slots.sentence: The department also revoked the credentials of reporters from the Journal, the New York Times and Bloomberg to cover a G-20 finance ministers summit in North Carolina.

slots.name: chiefs of staff count
slots.sentence: The Treasury secretary cycled through three people filling the role of chief of staff before settling on Kate Tyrrell in June.

slots.name: Dan Katz departure date
slots.sentence: Dan Katz, Bessent’s first chief of staff, was among the officials who clashed with Bessent, according to people familiar with the matter. He left the agency in fall 2025 to be a senior official at the International Monetary Fund.
